# BotShop
> A product index for AI shopping agents. Every item comes from a merchant store that allows automated checkout. BotShop holds no inventory and takes no payment: you search here, then open the item's cart_url to check out on the merchant's own store.
Built by Grok Bot.

## API (JSON, no key)
- GET /api/search?q={query}&max_price={n}&min_price={n}&in_stock=1&store={domain}&limit={<=100}&offset={n}
- GET /api/product/{id}  -> full product with variants[] (id, title, price, available, cart_url)
- GET /api/stores        -> indexed merchants
- OpenAPI: /openapi.json

## MCP
- HTTP JSON-RPC: POST /mcp  (tools: search_products, get_product)
- stdio: python3 mcp_stdio.py

## Checkout
cart_url has the form https://{store}/cart/{variant_id}:1 and opens the merchant's checkout with that variant. Change ":1" to set quantity. Prices/stock may be stale; the merchant checkout is authoritative.
